Title: Phase 5B checkpoint DPE=1048 km inconsistent with Variant label
Description: Checkpoint labeled Variant B has val_mean_track_dpe=1048.57 km. Variant A benchmark is 189.71 km. Deployed checkpoint significantly underperforms the published result.
Impact: Production inference underperforms published benchmark by 5x. Misleading if Variant A result is presented.
Recommendation: Confirm whether Variant A checkpoint exists and use it for demo. Verify checkpoint file identity.

Title: Ground-truth fallback in get_forecast when predictions_lookup is empty
Description: When sample_id not in predictions_lookup fallback uses imd_lat_12h ground truth coordinates as forecast output. All 371 TEST samples are stored so no active TEST leakage. VALIDATION/TRAIN queries would silently leak.
Evidence: api_contracts.py L154-159. All 371 TEST IDs confirmed present in predictions_lookup.
Impact: VALIDATION/TRAIN fallback presents ground truth as forecast without disclosure.
Recommendation: Add WARNING log and label response as FALLBACK_GROUND_TRUTH if fallback is triggered.

Title: Phase 6 intensity classifier accuracy 25.1% — below persistence baseline
Description: val_metrics: accuracy=0.2510 macro_f1=0.2006 per_class_f1=[0.255 0.167 0.368 0.158 0.218 0.238 0.0] Wind MAE=25.44kt. One class has zero F1.
Impact: Evaluators misled if intensity predictions presented without disclaimers.
Recommendation: Dashboard must show explicit disclaimer that intensity classification is sub-persistence and experimental.

Title: Artifact source URLs are placeholder — cloud deployment will fail
Description: All 4 model source_url fields contain placeholder.vayu-net.gov.in fictional domain. Download script uses these URLs at Render build time.
Evidence: manifest.json source_url contains placeholder.vayu-net.gov.in for all 4 model files.
Impact: Render deployment fails if download script runs without pre-populated storage.
Recommendation: Replace with real Supabase Storage URLs or disable download step until storage is provisioned.

Title: Default CORS_ORIGINS includes wildcard allowing any origin in local dev
Description: Default CORS_ORIGINS env var includes * making all origins allowed unless explicitly overridden in production.
Evidence: main.py L47: default string includes * confirmed.
Impact: Any website can make cross-origin requests during dev/CI.
Recommendation: Remove * from default CORS_ORIGINS. Require explicit opt-in.

Title: Analog cache candidate split field is UNKNOWN — provenance untraceable from cache
Description: All 696 candidates have split=UNKNOWN. Cross-ref with storm manifest confirms all are TRAIN. Cache cannot self-certify split provenance.
Evidence: cand_splits={UNKNOWN}. Storm manifest cross-ref: 81 distinct TRAIN storms.
Impact: Silent contamination possible if cache regenerated incorrectly.
Recommendation: Add split field to candidate entries. Add CI assertion that all candidates are TRAIN.

Title: Grad-CAM target layer is spatial_encoder.layer2 not Phase 6 classifier head
Description: target_layer=spatial_encoder.layer2 is inside the ResNet spatial encoder not the intensity classification output layer.
Evidence: explainability_manifest.json target_layer confirmed. Phase 6 state dict has no CNN layer keys.
Impact: Saliency shows what spatial encoder attends to — not what intensity head decides. Scientifically valid but must be disclosed.
Recommendation: Document target layer in dashboard and label as intermediate representation visualization.

Title: Phase 5B residuals show very high magnitudes (12h mean_mag=1702 km)
Description: val_metrics.residuals: 12h mean_mag=1701.97km median=566.88km. 24h mean_mag=2811km. 48h mean_mag=4391km. p90 DPE=2133-3774km.
Impact: Uncertainty cone polygons at p90 would span implausible geographic extents and confuse evaluators.
Recommendation: Clip cone radii with geographic sanity bounds. Display only p80 cones in dashboard.

Title: Phase 3C checkpoint shows only 2 epochs — possible training interruption
Description: epoch=2 in checkpoint. val_mean_dpe_km=703.0. TEST DPE=810.3km. Low epoch may indicate early stop or interrupted run.
Impact: Cannot confirm full training convergence. TEST worse than VAL by 107km.
Recommendation: Document training curve and convergence in phase3c docs. Confirm patience was exhausted.

Title: render.yaml buildCommand only checks artifacts not downloads them
Description: buildCommand runs download_runtime_artifacts.py --check which only verifies presence. On clean Render instance with no storage weights are absent and check fails.
Evidence: render.yaml buildCommand confirmed. Script --check flag verified.
Impact: Fresh cloud deployment will fail artifact check with no models present.
Recommendation: Change to run download (not --check) after fixing source URLs (F-04).

Title: 3 of 5 Grad-CAM demo cases are TEST split — should be labeled
Description: FANI=VALIDATION AMPHAN=VALIDATION TAUKTAE=TEST BIPARJOY=TEST REMAL=TEST. No leakage risk (post-hoc). Should be disclosed.
Impact: No statistical leakage. Perception of cherry-picking if unlabeled.
Recommendation: Label split membership in dashboard for each Grad-CAM case.

Title: vercel.json lacks installCommand — relies on Vercel default npm install
Description: No installCommand specified. If Node version constraints differ from Vercel default build may fail.
Impact: Frontend build may fail in CI on Vercel.
Recommendation: Add installCommand=npm ci and specify engines.node in package.json.
